What We Do

OUR SERVICES

From bulk haulage to precision earthworks, our plant hire covers every stage of your construction or landscaping project.

01

Tipper Trucks

Heavy-duty tipper trucks for efficient bulk material transportation — sand, gravel, rubble and fill on any site.

02

Backhoe Loaders

JCB TLB hire for excavation, trenching, loading, and backfilling on construction and civil sites.

03

Excavators

Powerful excavation machinery for large-scale digging, demolition, and foundation work on any project.

Site Preparation

Full clearing, grading, and levelling to get any construction site ready from day one.

05

Earthworks

Professional earthmoving for civil engineering, road construction, and large-scale land development.

06

Machinery hire for terrain reshaping, garden development, and all outdoor landscaping projects.
